paragraphs.source_en: Some believed that Shōnyū was using the inspection as a pretext to give his troops a brief rest. Others mistakenly thought that he had simply relaxed his guard after taking Iwasaki Castle. In truth, there was another reason.

units.source_en: Some believed that Shōnyū was using the inspection as a pretext to give his troops a brief rest.

ja.t: ませようとしているのだと

units.source_zh: 有人以为，胜入是以检为名，故意让士卒歇息一下。

units.source_en: Others mistakenly thought that he had simply relaxed his guard after taking Iwasaki Castle.
units.source_zh: 有人则误认为是胜入拿下岩崎城之后就松懈了。

units.source_en: In truth, there was another reason.
units.source_zh: 其实，有其他的原因。

paragraphs.source_zh: 有人以为，胜入是以检为名，故意让士卒歇息一下。有人则误认为是胜入拿下岩崎城之后就松懈了。其实，有其他的原因。

paragraphs.source_en: “Father!” The speaker was Shōnyū’s eldest son, Motosuke, Governor of Kii; his voice was slightly hoarse. Shōnyū glanced back at Motosuke but said nothing and continued riding onward.

units.source_en: “Father!”
units.source_zh: “父亲！”

units.source_en: The speaker was Shōnyū’s eldest son, Motosuke, Governor of Kii; his voice was slightly hoarse.
units.source_zh: 说话的是胜入的长子纪伊守元助，他的声音有些沙哑。

units.source_en: Shōnyū glanced back at Motosuke but said nothing and continued riding onward.
units.source_zh: 胜入回头瞥了元助一眼，没有开口，继续策马前进。

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲！”说话的是胜入的长子纪伊守元助，他的声音有些沙哑。胜入回头瞥了元助一眼，没有开口，继续策马前进。

paragraphs.source_en: “Father!” Greatly surprised, Motosuke spurred his horse and caught up with him. Only then did he notice that the corners of his father’s mouth were twitching and that a faint look of pain lay upon his face.

units.source_en: “Father!”
units.source_zh: “父亲！”

units.source_en: Greatly surprised, Motosuke spurred his horse and caught up with him.
units.source_zh: 元助深感惊讶，催马追了上去。

units.source_en: Only then did he notice that the corners of his father’s mouth were twitching and that a faint look of pain lay upon his face.
units.source_zh: 这时，他才发现父亲的嘴角在抽搐，脸上隐约有一丝痛苦的神色。

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲！”元助深感惊讶，催马追了上去。这时，他才发现父亲的嘴角在抽搐，脸上隐约有一丝痛苦的神色。

paragraphs.source_en: “Father, you look unwell. Have you been wounded?”

units.source_en: “Father, you look unwell. Have you been wounded?”
units.source_zh: “父亲，您脸色不好，是不是受伤了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲，您脸色不好，是不是受伤了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hush—” Shōnyū hurriedly shot him a warning glance, signaling him to keep silent.

units.source_en: “Hush—” Shōnyū hurriedly shot him a warning glance, signaling him to keep silent.
units.source_zh: “嘘——”胜入连忙使了个眼色，让他休要出声。

paragraphs.source_zh: “嘘——”胜入连忙使了个眼色，让他休要出声。

paragraphs.source_en: “First, report our victory to Lord Chikuzen. As for me, do not worry. I merely twisted my foot.” Shōnyū lowered his voice and patted his right foot. Whether Motosuke understood or not was unclear; he nodded, wheeled his horse around, and galloped toward the rear.

units.source_en: “First, report our victory to Lord Chikuzen.
units.source_zh: “先把战胜的消息报告给筑前大人。

units.source_en: As for me, do not worry. I merely twisted my foot.”
units.source_zh: 至于我，你休要担心，只是扭了一下脚。”

units.source_en: Shōnyū lowered his voice and patted his right foot.
units.source_zh: 胜入压低声音，拍了拍右脚。

units.source_en: Whether Motosuke understood or not was unclear; he nodded, wheeled his horse around, and galloped toward the rear.
units.source_zh: 也不知元助是否明白，他点了点头，扭转马头向后面奔去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “先把战胜的消息报告给筑前大人。至于我，你休要担心，只是扭了一下脚。”胜入压低声音，拍了拍右脚。也不知元助是否明白，他点了点头，扭转马头向后面奔去。

paragraphs.source_en: The morning sunlight poured over Mount Rokubō, and the dewdrops on the leaves glittered like strings of pearls. Shōnyū had a field tent erected and began what he called his inspection. This was no time to be wasting here… Shōnyū could not stop worrying about the forces of Mori, Governor of Musashi, and Hori Hidemasa, who had hastened there with him.

units.source_en: The morning sunlight poured over Mount Rokubō, and the dewdrops on the leaves glittered like strings of pearls.

ja.t: のようにきらめいていた。

units.source_zh: 清晨的阳光洒遍了六坊山，树叶上的露珠像一颗颗明珠，熠熠闪光。

units.source_en: Shōnyū had a field tent erected and began what he called his inspection.
units.source_zh: 胜入让人搭好营帐，开始了他所谓的检验。

units.source_en: This was no time to be wasting here… Shōnyū could not stop worrying about the forces of Mori, Governor of Musashi, and Hori Hidemasa, who had hastened there with him.

ja.t: になってならなかった。

units.source_zh: 现在可不该在这里浪费时间……胜入不住地担心随他赶来的森武藏守和堀秀政的部队。

paragraphs.source_zh: 清晨的阳光洒遍了六坊山，树叶上的露珠像一颗颗明珠，熠熠闪光。胜入让人搭好营帐，开始了他所谓的检验。现在可不该在这里浪费时间……胜入不住地担心随他赶来的森武藏守和堀秀政的部队。

paragraphs.source_en: At that very moment, however, Hori Hidemasa was resting at Kanehagihara, beneath the northern slopes of Iwasaki Castle, waiting for Ikeda’s assault on the castle to end. Hidetsugu had already crossed at the Matsudo ford and made camp in the Hakusan woods at Inokoishi. So these men had followed his example and stopped advancing as well… The thought filled Shōnyū with uncontrollable anger.

units.source_en: At that very moment, however, Hori Hidemasa was resting at Kanehagihara, beneath the northern slopes of Iwasaki Castle, waiting for Ikeda’s assault on the castle to end.
units.source_zh: 此时的堀秀政却正在岩崎城北山脚下的金萩原歇息，等待池田攻城结束。

units.source_en: Hidetsugu had already crossed at the Matsudo ford and made camp in the Hakusan woods at Inokoishi.
units.source_zh: 秀次则已经渡过松户渡口，安营于猪子石的白山林。

units.source_en: So these men had followed his example and stopped advancing as well… The thought filled Shōnyū with uncontrollable anger.

ja.t: めてしまったのか……そう

units.source_zh: 这些人竟也学了自己，停止了前进……一想到这些，胜入就气不打一处来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时的堀秀政却正在岩崎城北山脚下的金萩原歇息，等待池田攻城结束。秀次则已经渡过松户渡口，安营于猪子石的白山林。这些人竟也学了自己，停止了前进……一想到这些，胜入就气不打一处来。

paragraphs.source_en: After dismounting, Shōnyū endured the pain and walked three or four steps, trying to judge how badly he was hurt. But each time his right heel touched the ground, a stabbing pain shot through his entire body, as though even the tips of his hair were throbbing. It appeared that this was no mere sprain; the bone in his heel was probably broken.

units.source_en: After dismounting, Shōnyū endured the pain and walked three or four steps, trying to judge how badly he was hurt.

ja.t: がどれほどひどいのか

units.source_zh: 一下马，胜入忍着疼痛走了三四步，想看一看自己伤得是否严重。

units.source_en: But each time his right heel touched the ground, a stabbing pain shot through his entire body, as though even the tips of his hair were throbbing.
units.source_zh: 结果，每次右脚跟着地，一阵刺痛就袭遍全身，连头发梢都似疼痛不已。

units.source_en: It appeared that this was no mere sprain; the bone in his heel was probably broken.
units.source_zh: 看来，这次不是扭伤，脚后跟的骨头恐是折断了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一下马，胜入忍着疼痛走了三四步，想看一看自己伤得是否严重。结果，每次右脚跟着地，一阵刺痛就袭遍全身，连头发梢都似疼痛不已。看来，这次不是扭伤，脚后跟的骨头恐是折断了。

paragraphs.source_en: If I mix some vinegar and taro into a paste and apply it, the pain should lessen by half… So Shōnyū thought; then, to keep everyone from learning that he was wounded, he immediately put all his gear back on.

units.source_en: If I mix some vinegar and taro into a paste and apply it, the pain should lessen by half… So Shōnyū thought; then, to keep everyone from learning that he was wounded, he immediately put all his gear back on.
units.source_zh: 弄点醋和芋头，和成糊敷在上面，疼痛就会减半……胜入这样想，为了不让大家知道他负伤，又立刻穿戴整齐。

paragraphs.source_zh: 弄点醋和芋头，和成糊敷在上面，疼痛就会减半……胜入这样想，为了不让大家知道他负伤，又立刻穿戴整齐。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, Shōnyū found himself dumbfounded. The enemy heads awaiting his inspection numbered well over three hundred. Katagiri Hanyūemon even came to report that the men were vying with one another to present their trophies and wanted Shōnyū to inspect each head in person.

units.source_en: Before long, Shōnyū found himself dumbfounded.
units.source_zh: 未几，胜入就有些傻眼。

units.source_en: The enemy heads awaiting his inspection numbered well over three hundred.
units.source_zh: 供他检验的敌人的首级远远超过了三百。

units.source_en: Katagiri Hanyūemon even came to report that the men were vying with one another to present their trophies and wanted Shōnyū to inspect each head in person.
units.source_zh: 片桐半右卫门甚至来报告说，大家竞相来献人头，请胜入亲自检验。

paragraphs.source_zh: 未几，胜入就有些傻眼。供他检验的敌人的首级远远超过了三百。片桐半右卫门甚至来报告说，大家竞相来献人头，请胜入亲自检验。

paragraphs.source_en: At this rate, how long would the inspection take? A nameless anger surged within him, and Shōnyū first turned his gaze to the head of Niwa Ujishige.

units.source_en: At this rate, how long would the inspection take?
units.source_zh: 这样一来，要验到何时？

units.source_en: A nameless anger surged within him, and Shōnyū first turned his gaze to the head of Niwa Ujishige.
units.source_zh: 一股无名怒火涌起，胜入首先把目光转向了丹羽氏重的头颅。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样一来，要验到何时？一股无名怒火涌起，胜入首先把目光转向了丹羽氏重的头颅。

paragraphs.source_en: The head of the twenty-two-year-old Ujishige had been carefully prepared: his hair was neatly combed and the bloodstains washed away. His eyes seemed slightly open, as though he were mocking Shōnyū…

units.source_en: The head of the twenty-two-year-old Ujishige had been carefully prepared: his hair was neatly combed and the bloodstains washed away. His eyes seemed slightly open, as though he were mocking Shōnyū…

ja.t: とされている。わずかに

units.source_zh: 二十二岁的氏重的首级已经被仔细地整理过了，头发梳得很整齐，血污也已洗净，看上去微睁双目，似在嘲笑胜入……

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十二岁的氏重的首级已经被仔细地整理过了，头发梳得很整齐，血污也已洗净，看上去微睁双目，似在嘲笑胜入……

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed, this is… an auspicious sign.” Enduring the pain, Shōnyū forced a smile as he spoke.

units.source_en: “Indeed, this is… an auspicious sign.”
units.source_zh: “嗯，真是……好兆头。”

units.source_en: Enduring the pain, Shōnyū forced a smile as he spoke.
units.source_zh: 胜入忍着疼痛，强笑道。
